trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Pre-flight check**: Found checkout-api running unhealthy v2.3.1 across all 3 regions (18% error rate). v2.3.2 had never been in production, so the deploy was routed for change-manager approval per policy — **approved**.
2. **Deployed v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Status: `rolled_out`.
3. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** documenting the hotfix rollout (on-call paged).
4. **Post-deploy verification**: v2.3.2 is now healthy across all regions with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

The hotfix successfully resolved the v2.3.1 regression.
